name: a photon dimer resonator
notes:
Auto-designed from: Design an Ob3ect for:

a photon dimer resonator

phase_0.boundary_condition: sealed light tight enclosure with thermally locked pump and fiber output that contains the coupled ring pair and its measured spectrum
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: pump injection from bus waveguide into ring resonance
AFWD.justification: tunable laser drives photons forward into the dimer mode toward higher intracavity occupation

AREV.chosen_element: cavity decay and backscatter to the bus
AREV.justification: photon loss and reflection descend from the rings toward the input port as reduced field and heat

CLINK.chosen_element: evanescent chain from bus to ring A to ring B
CLINK.justification: sequential near field coupling links three stages so amplitude passes in order through the dimer

ENGAGR.chosen_element: coexisting bonding occupation with antibonding occupation under Kerr shift
ENGAGR.justification: cross phase modulation keeps bright tunneling and dark suppression live together during Rabi exchange

EVALF.justification: destructive interference negates transmission and single photon counts drop at the dark fringe

EVALT.chosen_element: bonding resonance buildup at zero detuning
EVALT.justification: constructive interference affirms photon accumulation and bright transmission peak

FFUSE.chosen_element: output combiner into one transmission spectrum
FFUSE.justification: bonding and antibonding arms interfere at the through port and rejoin as a single doublet trace with one correlation value

FSPLIT.chosen_element: supermode splitter into bonding and antibonding paths
FSPLIT.justification: one intracavity field opens into symmetric and antisymmetric spatial arms with opposite relative phase

IFIX.chosen_element: locked detuning table and doublet spectrum in nonvolatile store
IFIX.justification: heater setpoints and photon correlation traces are written append only and cannot be undone by later tuning

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: joint free spectral range matching itself
IMSCRIB.justification: the dimer recognizes its own mode spacing when ring resonances align and the doublet repeats

TANCH.chosen_element: closed enclosure with locked heater currents and sealed fiber output
TANCH.justification: thermal lid plus fixed pump wavelength holds the stabilized dimer emission inside a contained measurement boundary

VINIT.chosen_element: dark vacuum in two unpumped microrings
VINIT.justification: both cavities sit detuned and empty before pump arrival with no photon number established

phase_2.fuse_element: output combiner into one transmission spectrum
phase_2.fuse_result: single dimer transmission doublet with normalized coincidence trace that need not recreate the input pump field
phase_2.rejoin_note: bonding arm accumulates tunneling phase and Kerr shift while antibonding arm sheds reflected loss and a nested counting fork measures coincidences versus singles, then all arms rejoin at the through port detector
phase_2.split_element: supermode splitter into bonding and antibonding paths
phase_2.split_input: single intracavity field fed from the bus waveguide
split_outputs: bonding supermode arm with symmetric phase
antibonding supermode arm with antisymmetric phase
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) both held at once: bright tunneling and dark suppression present together as live dimer contradiction
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) negated: antibonding null formed and singles suppressed by blockade
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) affirmed: bonding peak built and coincidence clicks recorded
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) neither: dark cavities with no photon number established

steps.domain_action: dark cryostat holds two detuned microrings in vacuum
tunable pump drives bus waveguide toward critical coupling
bus field chains into ring A then evanescently into ring B
dimer aligns its joint free spectral range as self reference
intracavity field opens into bonding and antibonding supermode arms
bonding arm constructively reinforces at zero detuning
bonding photons tunnel coherently and accumulate Kerr phase
antibonding arm destructively interferes at zero detuning
antibonding leakage descends back to bus as reflected loss
photon stream opens into coincidence arm and singles arm for counting
coincidence arm registers simultaneous two cavity clicks for dimer pair
singles arm registers blockade suppressed single clicks
correlator holds bunching and antibunching signatures together during exchange
counting arms rejoin into single normalized g2 correlation trace
supermode arms rejoin into single dimer transmission doublet
error signal chains into thermal heater and piezo tuner for lock
locked detuning and spectrum appended to nonvolatile calibration store
shielded enclosure seals stabilized dimer emission at fiber output

phase_5.alfs_store: cold cavity transmission doublet and free spectral range table used as bootstrap calibration
phase_5.compiler_frontend: tunable laser driver and heater controller that translates detuning targets into pump wavelength and coupling currents
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: evanescent near fields and bus waveguide that carry amplitude and phase between rings and detectors
phase_5.memory_mechanism: intracavity photon occupation held in ring modes plus heater offsets retained in controller registers
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: cavity photon lifetime and detector gate clock that order injection, tunneling, decay and counting windows

phase_6.cycle_cost: pump photons scattered plus cooling power and detector dark counts per lock cycle
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 - pump energy exits as detected photons and heat while the stored calibration mirrors the field order
phase_6.post_cycle_state: locked dimer emitting stabilized doublet with logged spectrum and correlation trace
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: dark detuned cavities with empty modes and unlocked heaters
